facts.fact: The Ministry of Economy and Finance's 2025 SDG Eurobond report states that 12 new town halls used the services of the national administration network (RNA) in 2024; it is a count of additions in the year, with no cumulative total, beside the 77 communes the report gives for the country.
The report records 12 new town halls in 2024 as using the services of the state's national administration network, under the government's Administration intelligente project.

The report says the 12 new town halls of 2024 use 'the services' of the national administration network without naming them; the same table counts 12 new electronic mail-management (GEC) instances in 2024 at administrative structures, town halls and prefectures given as examples.

The report allocates EUR 6.43 million of the July 2021 EUR 500 million SDG Eurobond, a sovereign issue funding the public investment programme, to generalising e-services and digitalising the public administration, the line under which the 12 town halls joining the RNA in 2024 are reported.

The report names the Ministry of Digital Affairs (MND) as the ministry concerned for digital connectivity, with the state agency ASIN supplying tools to sector ministries; the RNA town-hall figure is reported under it.
